github.method: Connected GitHub GET tools; read-only. These are bounded observations, not a search of inaccessible private storage.
limitations: Repository-wide Actions artifacts endpoint was rejected by connector allowlist; four specific post-original publication runs were checked instead.
Remaining older 28 workflow runs were not inspected.
Other remote branches, expired artifacts and external/private backups are not exhaustively searched.

interpretation: No original payload recovered in the listed locations. This neither proves no original execution nor absence of copies elsewhere.
